visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a voluminous white fur coat over a purple top, speaks directly to the camera in a selfie-style handheld shot. She is standing outdoors at a harbor pier with several large white yachts and a modern urban skyline visible under a cloudy, overcast sky. She smiles brightly and uses animated hand gestures while looking into the lens. (2) The scene transitions to a wide shot of the harbor water where several colorful boats shaped like luxury sports cars are floating. These include a red Ferrari-style boat, a teal Rolls-Royce style convertible, and a green one. The camera pans across the water, showing the realistic car-like hulls, headlights, and interiors of these novelty vessels docked near the pier. (3) The woman and a young boy, both wearing bright red life jackets, are seen standing on a yellow Lamborghini-style boat. They wave and cheer at the camera with high energy. In the background, the distinctive white, honeycomb-shaped architecture of the Kaohsiung Music Center is clearly visible. The lighting is flat and natural. (4) The camera moves inside the yellow car-boat, showing the woman at the steering wheel while a man in a butterfly-patterned shirt and the boy sit in the passenger seats. They are cruising through the harbor, passing a large white Taiwan Coast Guard vessel. Graphic icons of cars appear as overlays during a sequence where the man speaks directly to the camera. (5) Various shots show the boat moving through the water, creating a small wake. The woman laughs while steering, and the boy nods his head with a wide grin. Another red car-boat is seen passing them in the opposite direction. The sequence ends with the group waving and cheering on the moving boat.
